content:
GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is a China-based chemical company headquartered at 13F, Pacific Plaza, No. 555 Jingjia Road, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. Positioned in one of the country’s most dynamic port cities, the company leverages Ningbo’s robust logistics infrastructure to serve customers across domestic and international markets efficiently and reliably. From this strategic base, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION focuses on the responsible sourcing, manufacturing, and distribution of a wide range of chemical products aimed at industrial, commercial, and specialty applications.

The company emphasizes rigorous quality management and regulatory compliance to meet the evolving standards of global markets. Its operations prioritize consistency, traceability, and safety across the supply chain, supported by supplier qualification processes and routine quality checks designed to safeguard product integrity. GRAND GROUP CORPORATION also places strong emphasis on customer service—providing responsive technical communication, tailored packaging and logistics solutions, and flexible order fulfillment to align with client timelines and specifications.

Sustainability and stewardship are integral to the company’s outlook. GRAND GROUP CORPORATION continually seeks to optimize processes, reduce waste, and encourage safer alternatives where feasible, working collaboratively with partners to meet environmental and occupational health expectations. With a solutions-driven mindset, the team supports customers in selecting suitable materials for their formulations and production needs, helping reduce risk and streamline procurement.

Rooted in Ningbo yet connected to a global network, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION strives to be a dependable partner for chemicals, offering a combination of product breadth, consistent quality, and logistical agility. Clients can expect pragmatic support, transparent communication, and a commitment to long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships. For inquiries or collaboration, the company welcomes contact through its Ningbo headquarters.
